description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'runCallsiteGuard' that performs static analysis on TypeScript files within a project, checking for specific callsite violations based on provided parameters. It imports utility functions for file collection and path resolution, and processes files to identify violations, outputting results accordingly.

methods.name: runCallsiteGuard
methods.description: Main exported function that performs static analysis on project files to find and report callsite violations based on passed parameters.
